overview: This file traces Japan’s political and economic transition under U.S. occupation from late 1948 through June 1949. Diplomatic reports, election analyses, intelligence guides, petitions, correspondence, and policy memoranda examine the January general election, party realignment, Communist activity, political purges, labor demonstrations, local elections, economic recovery, and proposals for a peace treaty and Japanese security.
interest: Contrasting U.S. mission and occupation headquarters analyses reveal disagreements over elections, political control, and Japan’s postoccupation future.
